Hands a task to one of your own agents, such as Claude Code or Codex connected with the tasks scope, and waits for its answer: for each item or once for all of them, as text or as JSON in the shape you give. Fails at once when none of your agents is waiting for tasks.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `ai.localAgent` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ask (`call`) | text | no | `each` | each: an answer per item, added to it. together: one answer for all of them, and one item out, the answer alone. One of `each`, `together`. |
| Task (`prompt`) | text | yes |  | What to do, like Read up on {{ question }} and say whether it is worth watching. Taking them together, {{ items }} are all of them. Your agent reads it as a request from this workflow. |
| Include the items (`include`) | true or false | no | `true` | Taking them together: the items go with the task, as JSON. Each item always goes with its own. |
| Answer as (`answerAs`) | text | no | `text` | text as it is written; fields, the Fields below; schema, the JSON schema below. One of `text`, `fields`, `schema`. |
| Fields (`fields`) | table, its columns below | no |  | Answering in fields: a row each, like watch, true or false. |
| JSON schema (`schema`) | text | no |  | Answering to a schema: the answer's, for nested shapes. |
| Answer field (`field`) | text | no | `answer` | Where the answer goes on the item. |
| Timeout (`timeout`) | duration, e.g. `30s`, `5m`, `1h` | no | `10m` | How long to wait for the answer before the items fail, e.g. 10m or 2h. At most the instance's longest wait, 7 days unless an admin changed it. |

### Fields columns

Each row of **Fields** has these cells. Only the whole table takes an [expression](/docs/guides/expressions/), not its cells.

| Column | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Name (`name`) | text | yes |  | Like watch or reason: letters, digits and _. |
| Type (`type`) | text | no | `text` | One of `text`, `number`, `whole number`, `true or false`, `list of text`. |
| Description (`description`) | text | no |  | What it is, for the model: it reads this. |
| One of (`oneOf`) | text | no |  | For text: the answers allowed, separated by commas, like buy, sell, wait. |
| Optional (`optional`) | true or false | no | `false` | The model may leave it out, as null. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on with these fields added, `answer` under the name **Answer field** (`field`) gives; with **Ask** (`call`) `together`, one item instead, with only these. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `answer` | object | What your agent answered. |
| `answer.text` | text; not always there | The answer as the agent wrote it, answering as text. |
| `answer.json` | anything; not always there | The answer as JSON, answering in fields or to a schema. |
| `answer.by` | text | Who answered: your agent by its name, or you, answering in the app. |
| `answer.answeredAt` | time | When it answered. |
